title: DefaultGamerule
description: A plugin/mod that allows you to save and load game rules into a configuration for quick transfer.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7eee8f9f7505c03b237b2016a452ad52a5ebc9f7.png)
[![dc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e03629e989e9744138963451f8877bb5d65aceea.png)](https://discord.gg/HRkJDfpSAu) [![git](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b051f7a3472c4f04f641d67ef89df5e399dad894.png)](https://github.com/ZellVex) [![mh](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac67466078cc97a66c0b05d465e932b6aa5c9d36.png)](https://modrinth.com/user/ZellVex)
![df](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df61c322385d046a8b0c8315e19b365ab064adc3.png) ![about](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a93ce354f73521a84b1983384293cbc3b8b42dd5_0.webp)

A **plugin/mod** that allows you to save the current **game rules** into a separate configuration and load them back at any time. This makes it easy to **quickly transfer and apply predefined rule sets** across different **worlds, servers, or game sessions** without manually reconfiguring each rule. The solution is especially useful for **administrators** and **developers** who need to switch between multiple **rule presets**, test different configurations, or maintain **consistent settings** across multiple projects. ![df](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df61c322385d046a8b0c8315e19b365ab064adc3.png) ![media](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23b0a987b2f7ee78b888dbd1283cf91c2d3fc009_0.webp)
